patches.old_text: - Android US apps can process in-app payments for digital goods; iOS digital goods require app-to-web flow (Stripe Checkout)
patches.new_text: - The April and November 2026 US-scoped overview says US iOS digital-goods apps **can** redirect to a Stripe-hosted Checkout page and US Android apps **can** process directly in-app using a third-party processor such as Stripe; it lists Payment Links separately. This overview does not make Checkout the sole iOS redirect, establish that Android has no other restrictions, or verify current app-store or merchant eligibility. See [[source-stripe-inapp-ios-android-purchases]] (https://docs.stripe.com/mobile/digital-goods; old raw/stripe-inapp-ios-android-purchases-2025.md:10-22; new raw/stripe-mobile-digital-goods-2026-11-07.md:11-23). Separate iOS Payment Links and merchant-owned Elements web checkout guides have their own dated scope.
patches.reason: Directly replace the active Checkout-only platform claim with the overview's conditional US examples and distinct Payment Links route.
warnings: Coordinator must merge this overlapping concept correction with independently reviewed Payment Links and custom-checkout concept patches.
